verdict.rationale: AWS documents official getting-started material: recommended onboarding tasks for beginners and tutorials that build and deploy a React app with Amplify, host a simple website, and build a Bedrock-powered serverless app. An official CLI install guide supports a command-line path. Nothing in the evidence shows these tutorials reach a running service in under an hour or present the exact commands step by step. missing for 10: evidence of sub-hour time-to-first-deploy, quickstarts showing exact copy-paste commands end to end, independent or hands-on corroboration of the onboarding speed.
